en: Tell me, \PN, are you afraid of the dark?

LUNA: The darkness in Master's heart bores a hole that I cannot hope to fill alone.

\PN, I'll be waiting.

Thanks for the save again, darling prince~

OPAL SHUTTER UNLOCKED

\PN?!

...GULP.

SANDY: W-what, this old thing?
It's just a...
...Piece of junk, yup!
I found it laying around so I was gonna go throw it away!

SANDY: Whaaaaat?
Pshaw, you're crazy!
\PN, isn't xe crazy?
There's no way I'd just happen to have taken this filter out of that machine or something!
ADRIENN: ...Uh huh.
All right, so supposing, just hypothetically, right?
Supposing you did take that filter from that machine...
Why would you have done that?
SANDY: Just hypothetically, right!
Umm, well, I suppose if that were something I would have done...
It must have been because this filter was passing cleaning chemicals that would be unhealthy for the Pokémon in Azurine Lake...
...And so I would have replaced it with one that would make the water even purer!
ADRIENN: And, in this hypothetical scenario...
Just where would you have gotten a filter like that?
SANDY: Um... That's--
ADRIENN: And would it have been an illegal acquisition?
SANDY: Ahaha, it's just hypothetical, so who really knows!
SANDY: B-besides! There were a bunch of Gulpin crammed into the machine anyway!
So, it was a good thing!
ADRIENN: And just how would you know that if you hadn't actually opened it?
SANDY: U-um...
ADRIENN: For your own sake, I hope you never have to testify in a court of law.
All right, listen.
The truth is, I've known that some of the chemicals permitted by the existing filter would probably still be harmful.
Unfortunately, a certain corporation has had their hands in the restoration financially and their ambassador has been trying to pull us around for it.
That person has significantly different values from many of us, and is only concerned about what can save them money.
And regrettably, that same company is the one we would have needed to finance this filter.
So here's what I'm going to do.
I'm going to report that the disturbance down here was just a gaggle of Gulpin, and nothing more.
And I'm going to forget I ever saw you here.
Please dispose of that filter somewhere no one will find it.
But let us please not cross paths like this again.
SANDY: Well, that could have gone worse!
But what xe said about that corporate ambassador really concerns me...
I won't let Reborn rot again!
Hmm... I know!
Let's sneak into the Grand Hall and find that corporate office!
Then we can put an end to their dark grasp on the city once and for all!
Skip cleaning the water on this file?
I'll kick that smirk right off of your face!

I must learn to control my competitiveness and aggression.
You're cordially invited, noob!

My willpower is superior! HAAAH!

Remember, remember...
What was in that lecture?
"When you strike the stone, it is not the force of the fist that breaks the rock, but the force of your will."
Something like that, right?
"Strength is not relative to those around you. It is an absolute force inside yourself, driving you through life."
What does that mean? I still don't understand.
KIKI: Greetings.
Are you a new student?
I see. Welcome.
Please, have a seat.
KIKI: Now, for today's lecture.
We will be reviewing the final principle for this curriculum, the art of void.
Void is the acknowledgement of that which cannot be known.
It is the understanding that all ideas are in themselves fallible.
For that reason, this principle cannot be taught; only considered.
Many people believe that some things are "right" and "correct" and others are not.
But these are not the laws of the world.
Concepts such as "virtues" or "evil" must not be given way to exist, for this is not the true void.
By perceiving that which exists, learn to perceive that which does not.
All things, even this instruction, must be questioned.
Just a visitor then?
KIKI: Hello again.
Please allow me now to formally welcome you as a student of Apophyll Academy.
We are honored to have earned your faith, and I look forward to observing your diligence and growth in the coming weeks.
I'll assign you a dormitory and schedule as soon as we return to the Academy.
Or was there something you required me for?
There is a threat to Apophyll?
This sounds quite serious.
And the Machine Strength...
Yes, we should have it.
But it sounds like there is much to discuss.
Everything in due time.
For now, please meet me in my room at the Academy, and we will officially enroll you.
It is the furthest back from the main entrance.
Allow me to finish my lecture, and then let us speak at length in my room at the Academy.
We will see what can be done.
I used to go to the Onyx Trainers' School, but the classes there were so boring!
Kiki's lectures aren't boring at all. They're short, sweet, and totally relevant.
I mean, who needs to know trigonometry anyway?
Shh, I won't be able to hear!
Emblazen me with your knowledge! I will become the power of words!
Hey, down in front, I'm trying to see!
I may come here just to fish, but I never miss a chance to attend Kiki's lecture.
Long walks and long talks.
That's what I'm about.
Oh, are you a new student?
Well, go on, take a seat.
Kiki's full of wisdom!
Someday I'll be as smart as her!
Hrm. Have a seat, listen well.
I don't always get what she's talking about... but it sounds deep.

Excuse me, would you be willing to look after Kricketot?

Well, well, Kricketot, looks like you're coming with me.
Um, don't worry! You'll be just fine!
SHELLY: Um... Bye! It was nice to meet both of you!

TRAINER: Of-of course... It would be an honor for Reborn's Bug Gym Leader to adopt my Dwebble...
Well, well, Dwebble, looks like you're coming with me.
I hope Kricketot is okay.
I hope Dwebble is okay.
